invariants.contract: PATCH narrators/:id renames the narrator in every book of the library (the new name is appended after the others), answers {updated: n}, bumps only those books' updatedAt, leaves other libraries and the item metadata file alone, emits items_updated with those items to users who can access the library, and updates the cached filter data.
Renaming a narrator to a name the book already has removes the old name without adding a duplicate, and books that only had the old name get the new one.
A narrator whose id contains percent-encoded + and = is renamed to a Unicode name; renaming a name no book has answers {updated: 0}, changes nothing and emits no event.

PATCH narrators/:id answers 401 without a token, 403 for a user without update permission, 403 without library access, 404 for an unknown library, 400 for a missing, empty or null name and for an invalid page (before the permission check), and changes and emits nothing.
